title: FactorHD: A Hyperdimensional Computing Model for Multi-Object Multi-Class Representation and Factorization
problem: Existing HDC models struggle to represent and factorize complex multi-object class-subclass relations; they suffer from superposition catastrophe and information loss when handling multiple objects simultaneously.
motivation: Neuro-symbolic AI requires efficient factorization for reasoning; HDC offers brain-inspired efficiency but needs expressiveness for hierarchical concepts.
method: FactorHD tags each object with a unique symbolic marker, allowing multiple objects to remain distinguishable when combined together and preventing the information loss that normally occurs in this situation (called superposition catastrophe in hyperdimensional computing). The factorization algorithm uses these markers to identify and eliminate redundant classes without losing any information.
key_novelty: Using unique symbolic markers for each object enables lossless extraction of class relationships in multi-object hyperdimensional representations.
contributions: Symbolic encoding method with memorization clause
limitations: Evaluation limited to CIFAR-10; scaling to larger datasets and real-world classification tasks not demonstrated.
